name: io.github.zhuyansen/new-term-radar
title: New-Term Radar
description: New AI model, product and repo names as they surface, and the search terms behind them, sized.

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: The radar itself has no dependencies; the server needs the MCP SDK.

packageArguments.description: Start the MCP server on stdio.

environmentVariables.name: AISA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AIsa key. Handles social discovery, model calls, and the fallback search route.

environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. DataForSEO API login; set with DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD to use direct search monitoring.

environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional. DataForSEO API password; set with DATAFORSEO_LOGIN.

environmentVariables.name: GOANYAPI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Adds what people searched together with each name, and one country's settled daily series.

environmentVariables.name: RADAR_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Absolute path to your config.json (X accounts, sitemaps, thresholds).

environmentVariables.name: RADAR_STATE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Absolute path to the directory that holds the radar's SQLite state.
